1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Bc5 5..strategy: Strikes in the centre with tempo: the pawn attacks both the bishop and e5. White leaves the e4 pawn loose for the moment, betting that the open centre and the pressure on the c6 knight are worth more than a pawn.

Steps out of the pawn's attack but keeps the bishop pressing on d4, and keeps the central tension instead of releasing it by capturing. Black accepts a little less space and asks White to resolve the centre first.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Nf6 4.O-O Bc5 5..name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Defence, Benelux Variation
